page.notes: Uncertain readings: "daico" at the start of the first line (the word before it is cut off at the scan edge; first letters unclear); "Atticæ" may read "Actiacæ" (the second letter is unclear); "agni" is hard to read; "allig- gent" line break. Italic extent in the Megillath paragraph is approximate. The two asterisks at the foot are a printer's mark, not a gathering signature, so they are left as a paragraph. The line "Verum ne ejusdem fidei agnoscatur," runs over to the next page and is printed as the last full line. The running head "AD LECTOREM." is in letter-spaced capitals.
